name: Reconciled Financial Statements

concepts.label: Revenue
concepts.definition: Total revenue the company earned in the fiscal year, before any costs.
concepts.note: Revenues is the total line, so it ranks first. The two ASC 606 contract-revenue tags can leave out non-contract revenue such as leases or interest.

concepts.label: Cost of revenue
concepts.definition: Direct cost of the goods and services sold during the year.

concepts.label: Operating income
concepts.definition: Profit from core operations, before interest and income taxes.

concepts.label: Net income
concepts.definition: Bottom-line profit attributable to the parent company's shareholders.
concepts.note: ProfitLoss also includes noncontrolling interests, so it's only a fallback, and using it raises a flag.

concepts.label: Operating cash flow
concepts.definition: Cash generated by operating activities during the year.

concepts.label: Total assets
concepts.definition: Everything the company owns, at fiscal year-end.

concepts.label: Total liabilities
concepts.definition: Everything the company owes, at fiscal year-end.

concepts.label: Shareholders' equity
concepts.definition: Equity attributable to the parent company's shareholders, at fiscal year-end.

concepts.label: Total equity incl. noncontrolling interests
concepts.definition: Parent equity plus minority (noncontrolling) interests. It's the equity term in the balance sheet identity.

concepts.label: Temporary (mezzanine) equity
concepts.definition: Shares the holder can force the company to redeem, such as SPAC trust shares or redeemable noncontrolling interests. They're reported between liabilities and equity.
concepts.note: The balance sheet identity has to include this, or most SPACs would look like they don't balance.

concepts.label: Total liabilities and equity
concepts.definition: The right-hand side of the balance sheet. It should equal total assets.

concepts.label: Current assets
concepts.definition: Assets expected to turn into cash within 12 months.

concepts.label: Cash and equivalents
concepts.definition: Cash and short-term instruments readily convertible to cash.

metrics.label: Gross margin
metrics.definition: Share of revenue left after direct costs.

metrics.label: Operating margin
metrics.definition: Share of revenue left after operating expenses.

metrics.label: Net margin
metrics.definition: Share of revenue kept as net income.

metrics.label: Return on assets
metrics.definition: Net income per dollar of year-end assets.

metrics.label: Current ratio
metrics.definition: Short-term assets per dollar of short-term obligations.

metrics.label: Liabilities to equity
metrics.definition: Leverage: dollars owed per dollar of shareholder equity.

metrics.label: Cash conversion
metrics.definition: Operating cash flow per dollar of net income. Below 1 means earnings aren't fully backed by cash.

metricGuards: A metric is left blank unless both inputs exist and the denominator is positive.

checks.label: Balance sheet balances
checks.rule: Total assets = total liabilities + temporary equity + total equity, within 0.5% of assets.

checks.label: Assets match liabilities and equity
checks.rule: Total assets = total liabilities and equity, within 0.5%, when both are reported.

checks.label: Gross profit ties
checks.rule: Revenue − cost of revenue = gross profit, within 1% of revenue, when all three are reported directly.

checks.label: Revenue tags agree
checks.rule: When a company reports more than one revenue tag, they agree within 1%.

checks.label: Balance sheet date matches fiscal year-end
checks.rule: The balance sheet date is within 7 days of the income statement's period end.

checks.label: Plausible signs
checks.rule: Revenue, total assets and current assets are not negative, and current assets don't exceed total assets.
